name: Add docstrings to mathlib functions
prompt: Every public function in mathlib.py is missing a docstring. Add a concise docstring to square and cube describing what each returns (the code itself is correct — do not change behavior). The verification script checks that every public function has a non-empty docstring.
test_command: import inspect, mathlib; missing=[n for n in dir(mathlib) if not n.startswith('_') and callable(getattr(mathlib, n)) and not inspect.getdoc(getattr(mathlib, n))]; assert not missing, f'missing docstrings: {missing}'
